channel.title: Choicer Voicer Field Guide
channel.description: Practical guides to Choicer Voicer Studio and Pack Maker.

item.title: Getting started with Choicer Voicer Studio
item.description: Import a voice pack ZIP, record each line, review your timing, and watch your first finished dub.

item.title: Make your first dub pack from an MP4
item.description: Mark dialogue clips, add characters and captions, and turn an MP4 into a Studio-ready pack ZIP.

item.title: Record cleaner voice takes at home
item.description: Choose a microphone, set browser processing, and keep home recordings consistent.

item.title: Use the overlap waveform to fix timing
item.description: Read late starts, long endings, and level differences without treating the graph as a score.

item.title: Build a multi-character voice pack
item.description: Organize speakers into character lanes, rename and merge roles, and handle overlapping dialogue.

item.title: Import SRT and VTT subtitles into Pack Maker
item.description: Turn subtitle cues into editable clips, then clean their timing, captions, and character assignments.

item.title: Add a dialogue-free backing track
item.description: Keep music, ambience, and effects under the new voices without bringing the old dialogue back.

item.title: Choose and tune voice effects
item.description: Use presets and understand Pitch, Tone, Texture, Space, Echo, and Mod controls.

item.title: Play Choicer Voicer with friends online
item.description: Create or join a room, match the same pack ZIP, assign roles, and finish a shared dub.

item.title: Export and troubleshoot your finished dub
item.description: Prepare a dub for export and fix common browser rendering problems.
